# LuFe/Mn/O Paper/Figure Fixture

This directory contains synthetic, sanitized document-side records for the LuFe/Mn/O known-answer publication-to-data bridge.

It intentionally contains no copyrighted figure image, no raw BT-7 data, and no generated real-data artifacts. The records encode only fixture metadata needed to test:

- one paper
- one figure
- panels `i`, `j`, and `k`
- panel composition labels for `x_Mn = 0.25`, `0.4`, and `0.5`
- elastic PSD figure intent
- Q and temperature axis constraints
- proposed panel-source candidate/link records
- deterministic source-support placeholders

Keep this document-side fixture separate from TAS SQLite data-file catalogs.
